item.tib: khro bo ngo mtshar rgyas pa'i rgyud las snying po gsham du gdags rgyu
item.coloph: bdag 'dra gyer spungs chen po yis/ ngo mtshar rgyas zlog gzhung chen gyi/ ti ka zhal shes rkang drangs rnams/ mkhas pa gsum gyis bskul btab nas/ phyi rabs sems can don ched du/ yi ger bris nas smon lam btab/ phyi rabs sgrub gshen rjes 'jugs ('jug)rnams/ gsang sngags zlog pa'i gzhung chen dang / zhal shes ti ka rkang grangs rnams/ gsang bar zungs la zab par spyod/ mkhas par spyod la gces par zungs/ snod la rtogs la gzhan la ston/ ces gsungs so//
